name: @cop/ingestion
description: INGESTION_DESIGN.md §3.1's first real ingestion pipeline: federal CourtListener/RECAP court-docket monitoring. Fetches candidate §1983 dockets, uses a Claude Haiku pass to extract an officer name from unstructured party text, matches against existing officers, and queues a review_queue candidate -- the same normalize -> dedupe -> [LLM] -> match -> queue shape every pipeline in that doc follows. State-court coverage (Juriscraper) is deliberately out of scope for this workspace; see INGESTION_DESIGN.md §3.1's state-courts section for the planned follow-up.
